artists.biography: Brad formed officially in 1992, although the band members had been playing together for a long time before that. The band's line-up was composed of vocalist Shawn Smith, guitarist Stone Gossard, bassist Jeremy Toback, and drummer Regan Hagar. The band originally wanted to go by the name Shame, however the band found that the name was already taken by a band featuring musician Brad Wilson. Instead, the band took the name Brad and decided to name its debut album Shame. Shame, released on April 27, 1993 through Epic Records, was recorded in roughly 20 days, with many tracks taken from in-studio jam sessions. Shame, featuring a raw sound and an eclectic mix of styles, was released to mixed reviews and moderate sales. The track "20th Century" was a minor hit in the UK.

perplexity.description:
In The Moment That You're Born is the fifth and final studio album by the American rock band Brad, released in 2023 via Loosegroove Records. Musically, the album continues the band's signature blend of moody, atmospheric rock with bluesy undertones and introspective songwriting. Brad, led by vocalist Shawn Smith and featuring members with deep roots in the Seattle music scene, delivers a collection of tracks that balance melancholy melodies with dynamic instrumentation, showcasing their evolution while staying true to their foundational sound.

This album marks a significant moment in Brad’s discography, serving as both a culmination of their musical journey and a farewell statement. After more than three decades and a series of critically acclaimed releases, In The Moment That You're Born stands as their last recorded work, reflecting on themes of life, legacy, and transformation. The album was met with positive critical reception, praised for its emotional depth and cohesive songcraft, with reviewers noting its maturity and resonance as a fitting conclusion to the band’s career.
